purpose: user 追加绘图请求：把既有 40 -> 10 -> 5 -> 2 -> 1 Mb 中间端点加入 Spearman boxplot，并展示该新链 200kb 与 1Mb 的 chr1 distance matrices
mode: read-only reuse of existing endpoints; plotting + evaluation-only reuse; no refit / no new optimization / no extra experiments

dataset.observation_unit: chromosome (20 correlated measurements in one cell), NOT a biological replicate

Extra levels.chain: 20 -> 10 -> 5 -> 2 -> 1 Mb (old 20Mb extra, not the new chain)

chr1_matrix_only_candidate.role: native 200 kb grid display only; never scored directly against the 1 Mb reference

reference.use: evaluation and display only; opened only after all candidate hashes were written
reference.one_mb_only: no 200 kb reference exists; no interpolation is fabricated

metric.name: signed Spearman rho (average-tie ranks)
metric.swap_rule: one whole-chromosome A/B swap per chromosome chosen from the four rho values by best matched pair sum
metric.same: mean rho of the matched copies
metric.cross: mean rho of the swapped copies
metric.na_policy: NA kept explicit, never nan-meaned into n=20

figures.four_way_same_cross_spearman.png: 4 versions x same/cross boxplot with 20 chromosome points each
figures.chr1_distance_matrices.png: 2 rows (matched to reference mat / pat) x 4 columns (Reference 1Mb / New chain 1Mb / New chain 200kb / 200kb->1Mb coarsened)

style.matrix_vmax: shared finite maximum over all eight panels

budget_limitation: all four endpoints are budget_not_converged and do not share an equal FG budget (1502 / 1902 / 1902 / 2202); the comparison is not equal-cost
scope_limits: one cell; no bootstrap, no significance test, no new null, no R1/R3, no new fitting; does not modify run 046 / 051 / 052
